title: ManiOS 0.26.0 dosprograms.info.tt applications batch

build.environment: QEMU 10.0.13 i386, CPU 486, 64 MiB RAM, serial console; one 16 MiB FAT16 IDE image per package, fresh disposable copy per case
build.docs_state: evidence written after e80fbe2; no DOS runtime source changed

method: Each case boots the 0.26.0 kernel, runs one dosrun command from the ManiOS shell, records the serial transcript and a screen dump, and sends Esc where an exit key exists. UI transcripts are cleaned of ANSI screen writes; the raw streams remain in the workspace logs. No program binaries or disk images are committed.

runtime_gaps.detail: All three stop on the same startup pattern: `mov [..],ah; mov dx,21h; cli; in al,dx; cmp ah,0FCh; jne +3; and al,0FBh`. The runtime rejects port reads other than its bounded 8254/video models.
Stops at `OUT 0F0h` before `DB E3` (`FNINIT`) and `D9 3F` (`FSTSW`). Consistent with Ability Plus 3.0, which stops on x87 `FNINIT`.
The DJGPP/go32 stub asks for a DPMI host: `Load error: no DPMI - Get csdpmi*b.zip`.

Both leave ManiOS shell/boot text in the headers and clear rows; VIEW short-file rendering overlaps the header with the document. This is the known incomplete BIOS text scrolling described in `dosrun.md`.

conclusion: Ten catalog packages were exercised. Figlet 2.2 completes a real banner-generation task and is Working. Directory Freedom, VIEW and EDITV are Partial. The AUMenu archive is Broken as shipped (Unix edition). Costa GUI, DATES, Cash Register, MinEd and As-Easy-As are Unsupported because they require a PIC read, x87/FPU instructions or DPMI. The dominant new blocker is the PIC mask read, which stops three unrelated applications in their startup code.
